GREG, 2026-11-07 about 02:25Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #508, message a119ae7c), verbatim: „Usuniecie content-v1 to follow up a nie warunek konieczny.” Asistant: write it down and apply it; removing content-v1 does not block delivery of Unified EO and is done as a follow-up.
Applied (Fable): Unified EO is delivered when E3(b) is installed, TermAl's M1, w-24a7 and w-8f4c run after the joint restart, E2 increment 1 has landed and the w-e072 live proof has passed. E3(c) legacy and content-v1/watcher retirement, TermAl's w-6f42 content-v1 deletion step and E2 increment 2 are follow-ups that don't gate EO; they become independent items rather than required children of the EO parents.

UPDATE, GREG 2026-11-10 about 19:44Z, via Asistant 43498a6e #870 (message 7cd6106e), verbatim: „Chciałym posprzątać po content-v1. Bardzo nie chce utrzymywac legacy kodu.” Asistant: prioritise the rest of the legacy source-identity removal and do it. Remove the unneeded production code and old inputs, and coordinate Engram w-9fcb, TermAl's remaining ContentV1 classifier/counter and the later source_revision column w-05a2. Keep stored historical values as Greg decided earlier, and prepare a proper migration for durable schema changes. Verify consumers, record the tasks, and report actual scope, owners and progress. Assigned 19:46Z by Engram::Fable: w-9fcb to Engram::Opus (session-7284), stage 2 first; w-05a2 to 12329 (inventory and migration plan first; the plan goes to Greg before any store is touched); TermAl's classifier to Fable2's team as a TermAl item.
